name: Wicked Gud Tomato Thumka Popped Chips
ingredients_raw: Chickpea Flour (38%), Rice Flour, Potato Flakes, Tapioca Starch, Sugar, Maltodextrin, Common Salt, Acidity Regulators (Citric Acid & INS 262(ii)), Dehydrated Vegetable Powder & Extracts (Garlic and Onion), Spices and Spice Extracts (Chilli, Cumin, Black Pepper & Clove), Dehydrolysed Vegetable Protein, Paprika Extract (INS 160c), Anti-caking Agents (INS 551 & INS 341(i)), Flavor Enhancers (INS 627&INS 631), Natural and Nature Identical Flavor Substances (Tomato), Edible Vegetable Oil (Sunflower Oil). Allergen Information: Contains Soy.
